title: StructuredDocument (I13 draft)
description: Extracted text of a PDF or long text as role-labelled segments, with figures and tables located on the page. DRAFT: lives in research/C1/I13 until C1 publishes it to Contracts/schemas/. See README.md beside this file for the rules.

engine.description: Which extractor produced this. Ground-truth engines exist only in research.

version.description: Monotonic per engine. Bumped by any change that can change `text` for some input (see the extraction version rule).

sourceSHA256.description: SHA-256 of the source file's bytes, so a later re-extraction can tell it is looking at the same PDF.

textSHA256.description: SHA-256 of `text` as UTF-8. Lets a consumer check it holds the text these ranges point into.

text.description: The canonical text. Every range in this document indexes into it, and it is the text written Margins anchor into for this extraction version.

segments.description: Contiguous, non-overlapping ranges of `text` in reading order, each with one role. Text between segments is whitespace only.

markers.description: Inline marks inside a segment: citation and footnote markers, inline math. Their characters are part of the segment's text; the speech path decides how they sound (I14).

floats.description: Figures and tables that can be shown on screen while their caption is read.

quality.description: Optional pre-check result (C1 M2): whether the app expects this document to sound bad, and why.

range.description: A span of `text` counted in Swift Characters (extended grapheme clusters), start inclusive: the unit of Anchor.startChar/endChar and SpeechTextNormalizer source offsets, so a Margin anchor and a segment range compare directly.

role.description: What the text is. Advisory to the speech path, which owns how each role sounds (I14).

pageIndex.description: Page where the segment starts, zero-based.

floatId.description: For a caption or table segment: the float it belongs to.

label.description: The marker as printed: "12", "3–5", "Smith et al., 2020", "*".

targetSegmentId.description: The reference, footnote or caption segment it points to, when known.

normalizedRect.description: Same convention as pdf-document-structure.v1: fractions of the page's crop box, lower-left origin, as PDFKit and Vision use.
